citations.title: Fly.io Security & Compliance Questionnaire
excerpts: **SOC 2 Type 2 (Sept 2026), HIPAA BAA.** SOC 2 Type 2: our current report was issued on September 3, 2026 by Aprio LLP and covers August 1, 2025 to July 31, 2026 (Security and Confidentiality criteria). It is available under NDA from the Trust Center to organizations with the paid Compliance Package. The report describes the Fly.io platform; it does not name individual products such as Sprites, which run on the platform it covers, and Tigris is not a subservice organization in it. A bridge letter is not needed inside the first quarter after the audit period and is available on request after that. We do not hold ISO 27001, a PCI DSS AOC or FedRAMP, and none are planned; for datacenter ISO 27001 we can supply the facility operator’s certificate for the region you use. HIPAA: our BAA is self-service in the Trust Center for organizations with the paid Compliance Package (see COMPLIANCE-31), with a separate Tigris BAA for object storage. We do not distribute penetration test reports (see SOFTWARE-1); we provide an attestation letter and the SOC 2 report instead.

citations.title: Fly.io Doubles Down on Computers for Agents with $25M to Deliver the Next Generation of AI Infrastructure
excerpts: *Funding, customer adoption, and new CEO Scott Johnston accelerate Fly.io’s vision for infrastructure purpose-built for AI agents and the applications they build.*

**SAN FRANCISCO — July 24, 2026 —** AI agents are transforming how software is built and deployed. For nearly a decade, Fly.io has helped developers build and run software. Now, as agents increasingly build, operate, and deploy software alongside people, Fly.io recognizes that AI agents require a fundamentally different kind of infrastructure than the disposable execution environments that defined the first wave of AI.

Fly.io is doubling down on computers for agents — connected infrastructure designed for AI agents and the applications they build. Fly.io gives agents real computers that have durable disk drives, secure connectivity to other systems, and the ability to scale to millions of instances to power production AI applications.

Fly.io just closed its strongest quarter in company history, driven almost entirely by agent workloads. More than 37,000 customers build on Fly.io, and more than 8,000 of them are agent-native. Over the past 12 months, revenue from the company’s largest agent-native customers has grown nearly 12 times. Among the company’s largest customers overall, agent-native companies now represent approximately two-thirds of revenue. Agent-first companies like Firecrawl, Kilocode, and Plastic Labs use Fly.io to build production AI applications that run continuously and perform real work.

To accelerate this opportunity, Fly.io also announced $25 million in Series D funding co-led by Dell Technologies Capital and Intel Capital, with participation from Andreessen Horowitz, EQT, Geodesic, and YC. Martin Casado, general partner at Andreessen Horowitz, and Daniel Docter, managing director at Dell Technologies Capital, will join the company’s board of directors. The investment will accelerate Fly.io’s leadership in computers for agents as organizations increasingly build and deploy production agentic AI applications.

basis.reasoning: Fly.io’s July 24, 2026 announcement states that it announced $25 million in Series D funding.

excerpts:
**URL:** \ **Category:** Fresh Produce\ **Tags:** machines, sprites\ **Created:** [October 23, 2026, 1:52pm UTC](https://community.fly.io/t/new-fly-mcp/28906 "2026-10-23T13:52:18Z")\ **Posts on this page:** 6\ **Page:** 1
... **Post date:** [October 23, 2026, 1:52pm UTC](https://community.fly.io/t/new-fly-mcp/28906/1 "2026-10-23T13:52:18Z")
Earlier this year, with the launch of Sprites, we released the Sprites MCP. That has been very useful for people using agents to work with Fly. But, it was always missing the rest of Fly. Now, we have a single MCP server with access to all of your Fly resources: [https://mcp.fly.io/](https://mcp.fly.io/) Visit that URL in your browser and you’ll get all the details about how to hook up the MCP server to your agent. Or, just point your agent at it and let it rip. You can manage machines, volumes, apps, and sprites.

basis.reasoning: Fly.io announced its unified MCP server on October 23, 2026, inside the six-month window preceding November 9, 2026.
